reading.title: Preparing for the Next Task: The Robotics Lab
reading.text: At the the robotics lab, a technician handles a real-world responsibility and must make a clear decision. First, the technician considers Power Supply, Testing Mat, Battery, and Humanoid. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the technician checks the details before moving on. Next, the technician considers Rover, Chassis, Track, and Code. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the technician checks the details before moving on. Next, the technician considers Algorithm, Loop, Function, and Debug. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the technician checks the details before moving on. Finally, the technician considers Compile, Variable, and Input. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the technician checks the details before moving on. By the end, the technician can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
